Name: (CP) Nyapu Style Portrait for Pickled Pete (Walk to the Desert - Redux Mod)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

﻿I was bored and decided to make a Nyapu styled portrait for Pickled Pete (Ghost) from the Walk to the Desert - Redux mod.

I used Harvey's Nyapu portraits as a base (and Lewis' shirt), and made four portrait versions to choose from (with an option for a lower opacity look), checkout the images tab for more details :)

You can change your the portrait of your choice in the generic mod configuration menu in-game and out.

Let me know if you'd like me to add anything!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png[/img]

This is a content patcher mod so it just needs to be put in your mods folder. Here's a step by step process:

[list=1]
[*]Download this portrait mod and unzip the file

[*]Place the unzipped '[CP] Nyapu Styled Pickled Pete Portrait' inside of your mods folder

[*]You're all done! Now you can play your modded stardew save with a matching ghost nyapu portrait instead of vanilla.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]

I can't thank [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu/mods?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]﻿ enough for open asset use permissions in order to make this mod possible: Checkout out their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Portraits[/url]﻿!

Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Tarniyar/mods?gameId=1303]Taniyar[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aeywoo/about-me?gameId=1303]Aeywoo [/url]﻿for open asset use permissions which let me add a new portrait style: Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8630]Main Mod[/url]﻿!

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
